content_sections.heading: IIM Indore Project Positions Recruitment 2026 Details of Positions
content_sections.text: A total of 107 project-based positions are available across five categories. The positions may be filled in a phased manner, as and when required by the project. Engagement may be discontinued before completion of the indicated tenure by giving 15 days' notice, based on project requirements and/or performance. Senior and Junior profiles are not intended to denote a hierarchical reporting structure - the reporting structure and organisation of these profiles will be determined by the Project Manager based on project requirements. Indicative Key Responsibilities: Project Manager: Oversee end-to-end execution of project objectives; coordinate field teams; monitor implementation and ensure timely delivery of project outputs and reports. Monitoring & Evaluation Specialist: Support development and management of project monitoring and reporting systems; undertake data reconciliation; compile risk registers for delayed projects; contribute to strategic recommendations and reporting. Advisors: Provide high-level strategic and sectoral review; assess institutional capacity and O&M sustainability; contribute to strategic recommendations and lessons for future project implementation. Technical Experts: Conduct technical quality assessments and audits; support physical verification; review technical specifications; assess long-term O&M sustainability. B.Tech. Engineers/ITI: Undertake ground-level physical verification of project sites; collect field data and photographic evidence; support data quality reconciliation; record initial observations.

content_sections.heading: IIM Indore Project Positions Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must be eligible, motivated, and qualified Indian nationals. The essential qualification and experience required vary by position - see the Details of Positions table above for the complete post-wise criteria.

content_sections.heading: IIM Indore Project Positions Recruitment 2026 Desirable Skills
content_sections.text: Candidates having one or more of the following shall be preferred: Experience of working on Government, externally funded, or large-scale infrastructure projects Knowledge of water supply, sanitation, environmental management, infrastructure development, public health engineering, or related sectors Working knowledge of AutoCAD, GIS, MS Office, project management software, data analytics tools, or other relevant engineering software Strong communication, documentation, analytical, and teamwork skills Willingness to undertake field visits and project-related travel

content_sections.text: Purely temporary and contractual Project-based and co-terminus with the project Tenure may be extended subject to project requirements and satisfactory performance No claim for regular employment, absorption, or continuation at IIM Indore shall arise from such engagement

content_sections.heading: IIM Indore Project Positions Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process may include one or more of the following: Shortlisting based on eligibility, qualifications, and relevant experience Written Test / Technical Assessment, if considered necessary Personal Interview The Institute reserves the right to adopt an appropriate selection process depending upon the number and profile of applications received. Mere fulfilment of the minimum eligibility criteria shall not entitle a candidate to be called for the selection process, and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for subsequent stages.

content_sections.text: Download and fill the prescribed Application Form available on the IIM Indore careers page. Attach an updated Curriculum Vitae (CV), self-attested copies of educational qualification certificates, experience certificates (wherever applicable), and other relevant supporting documents. Submit the duly filled Application Form along with all required supporting documents in the prescribed format, on or before 7 September 2026, through the mode specified by IIM Indore. For queries, candidates may write to [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: IIM Indore Project Positions Recruitment 2026 General Terms & Conditions
content_sections.text: These positions are purely temporary, contractual, and project-specific. Appointment shall not confer any claim for regular employment or absorption in IIM Indore. Interested candidates shall be required to submit the prescribed Application Form along with an updated CV, self-attested copies of educational qualification certificates, experience certificates (wherever applicable), and other relevant supporting documents. Applications received after the prescribed deadline or without the required documents may not be considered. Mere fulfilment of the minimum eligibility criteria shall not entitle a candidate to be called for the selection process. The Institute reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of positions, modify the eligibility criteria, cancel the recruitment process, or not fill any or all positions without assigning any reason. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for the subsequent stages of the selection process. No correspondence regarding the recruitment process shall be entertained. Any form of canvassing shall lead to disqualification. The decision of IIM Indore shall be final and binding in all matters relating to the recruitment process.

faq.question: Q1. What is IIM Indore Project Positions Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is an advertisement by the Indian Institute of Management Indore inviting applications from eligible Indian nationals for temporary, contractual, project-based positions.

faq.question: Q2. How many positions are available?
faq.answer: 107 positions across five categories: Project Manager (1), Monitoring & Evaluation Specialist (2), Advisors (4), Technical Experts (10), and B.Tech Engineers/ITI with experience (90).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
Q4. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by position, ranging from Matriculation/ITI or B.Tech (3rd/4th year or fresh graduate) for field-level roles, to Ph.D./Postgraduate degrees in Engineering, Management, or related disciplines for Project Manager, Advisor, and Technical Expert roles.

faq.question: Q5. What is the tenure of these positions?
faq.answer: Tenure varies by position: 3 months (extendable up to 2 additional months) for B.Tech Engineers/ITI; an initial 4 months extendable up to 7 months for Advisors and Technical Experts; and 7 months (full project lifecycle tenure) for the Project Manager and Monitoring & Evaluation Specialist.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for IIM Indore Project Positions Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By submitting the prescribed Application Form along with an updated CV and supporting documents, through the mode specified by IIM Indore, on or before 7 September 2026.
